safety.v117_policy: Feature code is materialized with git show and copied only to /tmp on source host/container. Focused tests run before live corpus reads. GamerAccounting and Business Central are read-only. Corpus persistence is false. /app is unchanged. No restart, SharePoint move/upload, Mongo mutation, BC write, or Production routing authority is permitted.

next_after_success: If V117 reaches zero wrong automatic routes, 100% automatic accuracy, and at least 90% heldout coverage, integrate the learned AP router shadow-first in UAT while the deterministic route remains authoritative and accumulate real intake telemetry. Production remains untouched until explicit authorization.
notes: Detailed V115/V116 history remains preserved in Git history through control commit 538f5180071ce40dcd833b28734f9b4cbfe89d2c. V117 does not lower the gate. It adds stable-workflow consensus, variable-workflow semantic discrimination, reference-family safety, narrower cross-vendor-reference dependence checks, and targeted vendor corpus expansion. The Tumalo fixture explicitly recreates the V116 pre-authority Warehouse selection before asserting forced review. The Graphic fixture explicitly asserts the unsafe raw cost-variance proposal, pre-authority review state, stable DO NOT PAY evidence, and evidence-backed promotion to DO NOT PAY.
